headline: Homelessness pilot program, Cannon Plaza Chapter 46 revision, airport leases, and Biddeford Housing Authority TIF/CEA amendment.
summary: Main business includes a homelessness pilot program and a revision to Chapter 46 for Cannon Plaza. Other items cover airport leases, the appointment of Laurie Smith as City Manager, and a Biddeford Housing Authority TIF/CEA amendment presentation.
